counter_capture.scope: GPU Engine counters and process names only; no window contents or command lines
counter_capture.note: Seconds is the sample count for backward compatibility; elapsed time may be longer. Counter statuses 0 and 1 are valid; other values are retained for rejection.
counter_capture.discovery: Wildcard instances are refreshed before every independently primed sample. Short-lived processes and gaps between queries can be missed.

notes: Only entire counter query intervals within inference are included.
Each engine is retained separately; utilization percentages are not added.
A Neural engine on the verified Arc GPU is GPU activity, not NPU activity.
The outer desktop still uses DWM; scanout timing is not measured.
Paired ratios and ratios of descriptive condition medians are different statistics.
